name: Nakamurabashi
tagline: Shinjuku in 27 minutes and Shibuya in 32 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 38 minutes to Otemachi, 27 minutes to Shinjuku, 32 minutes to Shibuya and 53 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 42.4 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 8.3 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 42.4 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 35.3 m to 43.6 m, a difference of 8.3 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 6 fall inside the area, and the deepest projection among them is 0.5 to 3 m. The projected depth differs block by block within the same station area, so check the ward hazard map for the specific address. Inland flooding from overwhelmed drains has no nationwide map; each ward publishes its own, and that is worth reading as well.

groceries.name: ザ・ガーデン自由が丘

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 17 clinics and 13 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 秀佑会東海病院, about 9 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 忠医会病院, about 27 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Ikebukuro Line.
congestion: Seibu Ikebukuro Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 椎名町→池袋, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥140,000 to ¥150,000 and 2LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

neighbours.lead: Fujimidai is ahead on how little of the area is in the flood projection and quiet, but Nakamurabashi is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Nakamurabashi. One-room rents run about ¥5,000 higher.

neighbours.lead: Toshimaen is ahead on the number of lines and how little of the area is in the flood projection, but Nakamurabashi is ahead on the number of medical facilities.
neighbours.note: About 1 km away in a straight line. It reaches Otemachi in about the same time as Nakamurabashi.

noiseSources: 中杉通り (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
千代田練馬田無線（補助第133号線） (a main road) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 15 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: Among the 23 wards' stations, comparatively few of the points around this one fall inside the projected inundation area for the largest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are lightly loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
